annotations.title: Set the support name and avatar on Summer's approved Slack replies, with the expected revision and a reason

description: Set the support name and avatar on Summer's approved Slack replies, with the expected revision and a reason. Null values use the plain Summer Ellis identity. Sends no message.

avatar_url.description: Public https image link for the reply avatar.

display_name.description: Support name shown on replies, such as the company's support team name. Slack still marks the post as an app.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same key when retrying the same change

revision.description: Current revision from slack.identity.read; 0 before the first save.
